title: Yahoo rejects the saved login with 403 on every request
description: Every Fantasy API call, and the OpenID userinfo call, returns 403 'This application is not authorized to perform this action' even with a freshly refreshed token. Needs the manager to sign in again in a browser (delete ~/.config/yahoo-fantasy-mcp/tokens.json, call a tool) and, if that fails, check the Yahoo developer app still has Fantasy Sports read permission. auth.ts requests scope 'openid' only; if re-auth alone does not fix it, try 'fspt-r'. Blocks live verification in phases 2-4, fixture recording, and confirming the league is head-to-head categories.

title: Phase 4: real analytics
description: Projection: banked totals + available players' averages x games remaining, capped by active slots per day; percentage categories from makes/attempts; averages window default last 30 days, fallback last season. Streams: free agents ranked by expected gain in close categories (overridable), showing games remaining; no drop suggestions. Schedule from NBA public feed cached a day, after confirming Yahoo cannot supply it; write ADR then.

title: Phase 2: identity
description: My Team derived from the Yahoo login; team_key stays as optional override. Default League auto-selected when the manager is in exactly one NBA league this season, otherwise chosen. Add list_my_leagues. Current season only. Confirm league is head-to-head categories.

title: Phase 3: shaped output
description: Compact responses with named stats instead of raw Yahoo JSON. Tools may be renamed or merged; no raw flag. Verify what Yahoo's lastmonth window covers and fix descriptions. Anonymised recorded fixtures.

title: Epic: improve Yahoo Fantasy Basketball MCP
description: Four phases, one PR each: health, identity, shaped output, real analytics. Vocabulary in CONTEXT.md. Deferred: write actions, draft tooling, npm publishing.

title: Phase 1: health
description: Yahoo errors surface as real tool errors with readable messages (no '[object Object]', no error-as-success). One schema per tool (drop duplicated hand-written JSON schemas). Types instead of any at the tool boundary. npm test exits (vitest run). Tests for the client and tool handlers. Minimal CI: build + tests on push. Tighten tokens.json to 0600 on write. Diagnose the current get_league_settings failure (suspect stale nba.l.35158).
close_reason: Merged in PR #1. Live 403 is an authorization problem, not a stale league key; needs browser sign-in.
